name: Yamada Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Yamada Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the consumer electronics retailing activities in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Consumer Electronics, Housing, Financial, and Environment Business. The company offers home electrical appliances, such as Televisions, refrigerators, and washing machines; home information appliances, including computers and mobile phones; housing-related products comprises furniture and home interiors provision of renovation services.
